title: Madhya-khanda, part 1 (portion 24)
html:
The beginning of the Madhya-khanda: the Lord teaches His students that true knowledge is devotion to Krishna; in the mood of Radha He weeps in separation, and by His word Shachi attains prema; prema in the house of Shuklambara; the Lord's associates gather; the sound of the flute and the mood of Gandharvika; the heavenly voice: "You are Ishvara Himself"; the mood of the Boar in Murari's house, the talk about the Vedas, the instruction to worship Radha and Krishna, Murari sees Rama; the explanation of the verse on the holy name

Prema-dana-lila (The Lord bestows prema)

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. The author, having praised the good fortune of those who were Sriman Mahaprabhu's students in His lila of teaching, describes the lila of the Lord's mercy to mother Shachi. One day, when Sriman Mahaprabhu was resting in His house, He suddenly, Himself absorbed in the mood of Srimati Radhika in separation [when Krishna had gone] to Mathura, began to weep, crying: "O Krishna, O Krishna!" Hearing the weeping, Shachi-devi came there and begged Gaurasundara for prema, and Gaurasundara bestowed prema on her. Then in the house of Shuklambara Brahmachari He enacted the lila of the great manifestation of prema. Bereft of all outward awareness, He wept all the time, crying "O Krishna!"; and hearing someone sing the name of Krishna, He fainted in bliss. Moment by moment the eight sattvika-bhavas arose all over His body, and anubhavas such as dancing, singing and rolling on the ground appeared. Gaurasundara, though Bhagavan Himself, accepted the mood of a devotee and revealed the glory of bhakti and of the devotees — therefore He is the crown jewel of all avataras. When Sriman Mahaprabhu began the lila of preaching prema, the devotees headed by Gadadhara and devotees from various lands and countries all gathered together. By Gaurahari's mercy all were maddened with prema. One day the Lord was walking with Srivasa Pandita and his brothers, and suddenly, hearing the sound of Krishna's flute, He attained the state that Srimati Gandharvika had attained and, like a madman, began to display loud laughter, weeping, silence, humility and other anubhavas. Then a heavenly voice resounded: "O Vishvambhara! You are Bhagavan Himself, descended to the earth to preach prema." When in Murari's house the Lord manifested the form of the Boar, Murari praised Him and begged the Lord for prema; the Lord told him to worship the son of the king of Vraja, served by the cowherd men and women. When Murari wished to see the form of Ramachandra, the Lord showed him that form and glorified the greatness of the name of Krishna. Further are described the coming of Brahma and the other gods to Gaura with prayers for prema, their attaining prema by Gaura's mercy and their dancing with cries of "O Radha, O Govinda!", the mercy to Shuklambara Brahmachari, the garland from the Lord's body given to Gadadhara, the wondrous beauty of the pair Gaura and Gadadhara, and so on1.

Raga karuna-shri

জয় নরহরি-গদাধর-প্রাণনাথ ।
কৃপা করি কর প্রভু শুভ দৃষ্টিপাত ॥ ১ ॥

jaẏa narahari-gadādhara-prāṇanātha |
kṛpā kari kara prabhu śubha dṛṣṭipāta || 1 ||

jaya — glory; narahari-gadadhara-prananatha — to the Lord of the life of Narahari and Gadadhara; kripa kari — mercifully; kara prabhu — cast, Lord; shubha drishtipata — an auspicious glance

1Glory to You, Lord of the life of Narahari and Gadadhara!
Be merciful, Lord — cast on us Your auspicious glance.

আদিখণ্ড সায় মধ্যখণ্ডের আরম্ভ ।
যা শুনিলে প্রেমধন পাবে অবিলম্ব ॥ ২ ॥

ādikhaṇḍa sāẏa madhyakhaṇḍera ārambha |
yā śunile premadhana pābe abilamba || 2 ||

adikhanda saya — the Adi-khanda is ended; madhyakhandera arambha — the beginning of the Madhya-khanda; ya shunile — by hearing which; prema-dhana — the treasure of prema; pabe avilamba — one will obtain at once

2The Adi-khanda is ended — the beginning of the Madhya-khanda:
whoever hears it will at once obtain the treasure of prema.

মধ্যখণ্ড-কথা কহি অমৃতের সার ।
নদিয়া-বিহার যাথে প্রেমার প্রচার ॥ ৩ ॥

madhyakhaṇḍa-kathā kahi amṛtera sāra |
nadiẏā-bihāra yāthe premāra pracāra || 3 ||

madhyakhanda-katha kahi — I tell the story of the Madhya-khanda; amritera sara — the essence of nectar; nadiya-vihara — the pastimes in Nadia; yathe — in which; premara prachara — the preaching of prema

3I tell the story of the Madhya-khanda — the essence of nectar,
where are the pastimes in Nadia and the preaching of prema,

জগাই-মাধাই পাপী যাহে উদ্ধারিলা ।
ব্রহ্মার দুর্লভ প্রেম যারে তারে দিলা ॥ ৪ ॥

jagāi-mādhāi pāpī yāhe uddhārilā |
brahmāra durlabha prema yāre tāre dilā || 4 ||

jagai-madhai papi — the sinners Jagai and Madhai; yahe uddharila — where He delivered; brahmara durlabha prema — prema rare for Brahma; yare tare dila — was given to one and all

4where the sinners Jagai and Madhai were delivered,
where prema, rare even for Brahma, was given to one and all,

হরিনাম-সঙ্কীর্তন যাহাতে প্রকাশ ।
পতিত-উদ্ধার-হেতু যাহাতে সন্ন্যাস ॥ ৫ ॥

harināma-saṅkīrtana yāhāte prakāśa |
patita-uddhāra-hetu yāhāte sannyāsa || 5 ||

harinama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of the name of Hari; yahate prakasha — in which is manifested; patita-uddhara-hetu — for the deliverance of the fallen; yahate sannyasa — in which is sannyasa

5where the sankirtana of the name of Hari was manifested,
where — for the deliverance of the fallen — sannyasa.

কহিব এ সব কথা অমৃতের খণ্ড ।
যা শুনিলে ঘুচে জীবের অন্তর-পাষণ্ড ॥ ৬ ॥

kahiba e saba kathā amṛtera khaṇḍa |
yā śunile ghuce jībera antara-pāṣaṇḍa || 6 ||

kahiba e saba katha — I shall tell all this; amritera khanda — morsels of nectar; ya shunile — by hearing which; ghuche jivera antara-pashanda — the godlessness in the soul's heart vanishes

6I shall tell all this — morsels of nectar:
whoever hears it, from his heart godlessness will vanish.

নদিয়া আসিয়া প্রভু আনন্দিত-চিতে ।
সুখে নিবসয়ে বন্ধু-বান্ধব-সহিতে ॥ ৭ ॥

nadiẏā āsiẏā prabhu ānandita-cite |
sukhe nibasaẏe bandhu-bāndhaba-sahite || 7 ||

nadiya asiya — having come to Nadia; prabhu anandita-chite — the Lord with a joyful heart; sukhe nivasaye — lives happily; bandhu-bandhava-sahite — with relatives and friends

7Having returned to Nadia, the Lord with a joyful heart
lives happily together with His relatives and friends.

নবদ্বীপবাসী যত ব্রাহ্মণকুমার ।
সৎকুলসম্ভব তারা অতি শুদ্ধাচার ॥ ৮ ॥

nabadbīpabāsī yata brāhmaṇakumāra |
satkulasambhaba tārā ati śuddhācāra || 8 ||

navadvipa-vasi — living in Navadvipa; yata brahmana-kumara — all the brahmana youths; sat-kula-sambhava tara — born of good families; ati shuddhachara — very pure in conduct

8All the brahmana youths living in Navadvipa
are born in good families and very pure in conduct.

বড় সুকৃতী তারা ধন্য তিনলোকে ।
আপনে ঠাকুর বিদ্যাদান দিল যাকে ॥ ৯ ॥

baṛa sukṛtī tārā dhanya tinaloke |
āpane ṭhākura bidyādāna dila yāke || 9 ||

bada sukriti tara — great is their merit; dhanya tina-loke — blessed in the three worlds; apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; vidya-dana dila yake — to whom He gave knowledge

9Great is their fortune, they are blessed in the three worlds:
the Thakura Himself bestowed knowledge on them.

সব শিষ্যগণে একদিন গৌরহরি ।
বলিল সভারে প্রভু অনুগ্রহ করি ॥ ১০ ॥

saba śiṣyagaṇe ekadina gaurahari |
balila sabhāre prabhu anugraha kari || 10 ||

saba shishya-gane — to all the students; ekadina gaurahari — one day Gaurahari; balila sabhare prabhu — the Lord said to all; anugraha kari — showing favour

10One day Gaurahari, the Lord, showing His favour,
said to all His students:

পড় এক সত্য বস্তু কৃষ্ণের চরণ ।
সেই বিদ্যা যাথে হরিভক্তির লক্ষণ ॥ ১১ ॥

paṛa eka satya bastu kṛṣṇera caraṇa |
sei bidyā yāthe haribhaktira lakṣaṇa || 11 ||

pada — study; eka satya vastu — the one true reality; krishnera charana — the feet of Krishna; sei vidya — that is knowledge; yathe haribhaktira lakshana — in which is the mark of devotion to Hari

11"Study the one true reality — the feet of Krishna:
that is knowledge in which there is the mark of devotion to Hari.

তাহা বিনু অবিদ্যা সকল শাস্ত্রে কহে ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-ভক্তি বিনে কেহো সঙ্গী নহে ॥ ১২ ॥

tāhā binu abidyā sakala śāstre kahe |
rādhākṛṣṇa-bhakti bine keho saṅgī nahe || 12 ||

taha vinu — without it; avidya sakala — all is ignorance; shastre kahe — say the shastras; radha-krishna-bhakti vine — without devotion to Radha and Krishna; keho sangi nahe — no one is a companion

12Without it, say the shastras, all is ignorance;
without devotion to Radha and Krishna no one is our companion.

বিদ্যা-কুল-ধন-মদে কৃষ্ণ নাহি পায় ।
ভক্তিতে সে অনায়াসে পাই যদুরায় ॥ ১৩ ॥

bidyā-kula-dhana-made kṛṣṇa nāhi pāẏa |
bhaktite se anāẏāse pāi yadurāẏa || 13 ||

vidya-kula-dhana-made — by pride of learning, birth and wealth; krishna nahi paya — Krishna is not attained; bhaktite se — but by devotion; anayase — easily; pai yaduraya — one attains the Lord of the Yadus

13By pride of learning, birth and wealth Krishna is not attained,
but by devotion one easily attains the Lord of the Yadus.

ভক্তিরসে বশ কৃষ্ণ দেখহ বিচারি ।
এত কহি শ্লোক পড়ে শাস্ত্র-অনুসারি ॥ ১৪ ॥

bhaktirase baśa kṛṣṇa dekhaha bicāri |
eta kahi śloka paṛe śāstra-anusāri || 14 ||

bhakti-rase — by the rasa of devotion; vasha krishna — Krishna is subdued; dekhaha vichari — consider; eta kahi — saying this; shloka pade — He recites a shloka; shastra-anusari — following the shastras

14Consider: Krishna is subdued by the rasa of devotion" —
saying this, He recites a shloka in accordance with the shastras.

Thus in the Padyavali (the words of a southern poet):

ব্যাধস্যাচরণং ধ্রুবস্য চ বয়ো বিদ্যা গজেন্দ্রস্য কা
কুব্জায়াঃ কিমু নাম রূপমধিকং কিং তৎ সুদাম্নো ধনম্ ।
বংশঃ কো বিদুরস্য যাদবপতেরুগ্রস্য কিং পৌরুষং
ভক্ত্যা তুষ্যতি কেবলং ন চ গুণৈর্ভক্তিপ্রিয়ো মাধবঃ ॥ ১৫ ॥

byādhasyācaraṇaṃ dhrubasya ca baẏo bidyā gajendrasya kā
kubjāẏāḥ kimu nāma rūpamadhikaṃ kiṃ tat sudāmno dhanam |
baṃśaḥ ko bidurasya yādabapaterugrasya kiṃ pauruṣaṃ
bhaktyā tuṣyati kebalaṃ na ca guṇairbhaktipriẏo mādhabaḥ || 15 ||

vyadhasya acharanam — the conduct of the hunter; dhruvasya cha vayah — and the age of Dhruva; vidya gajendrasya ka — what the learning of Gajendra; kubjayah kimu nama rupam adhikam — what the name and beauty of Kubja; kim tat sudamnah dhanam — what the wealth of Sudama; vamshah kah vidurasya — what the lineage of Vidura; yadava-pateh ugrasya kim paurusham — what the prowess of Ugrasena, lord of the Yadavas; bhaktya tushyati kevalam — is pleased by devotion alone; na cha gunaih — not by qualities; bhakti-priyah madhavah — Madhava, who loves devotion

15"What was the conduct of the hunter, what the age of Dhruva, what the learning of Gajendra, what the name and beauty of Kubja, what the wealth of Sudama, what the lineage of Vidura, what the prowess of Ugrasena, lord of the Yadavas? Madhava, who loves devotion, is pleased by devotion alone, not by qualities"2.

এইমতে শিষ্যগণে পড়ায় ঠাকুর ।
প্রকাশিব নিজপ্রেম আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ১৬ ॥

eimate śiṣyagaṇe paṛāẏa ṭhākura |
prakāśiba nijaprema ānanda pracura || 16 ||

eimate — thus; shishya-gane padaya thakura — the Thakura teaches His students; prakashiba nija-prema — I shall reveal My prema; ananda prachura — abundant bliss

16Thus the Thakura taught His students,
[intending] to reveal His prema — abundant bliss.

একদিন নিজগৃহে আছয়ে শুইয়া ।
কৃষ্ণপ্রেমানন্দে কান্দে বিহ্বল হইয়া ॥ ১৭ ॥

ekadina nijagṛhe āchaẏe śuiẏā |
kṛṣṇapremānande kānde bihbala haiẏā || 17 ||

ekadina — one day; nija-grihe achhaye shuiya — lying in His house; krishna-premanande — in the bliss of love for Krishna; kande vihvala haiya — He weeps, overwhelmed

17One day, lying in His house,
He weeps, overwhelmed by the bliss of love for Krishna.

রাধাভাবে ব্যাকুল হইয়া প্রভু ডাকে ।
মাথুর-বিরহে হাথ মারে নিজবুকে ॥ ১৮ ॥

rādhābhābe byākula haiẏā prabhu ḍāke |
māthura-birahe hātha māre nijabuke || 18 ||

radha-bhave — in the mood of Radha; vyakula haiya — agitated; prabhu dake — the Lord calls out; mathura-virahe — in the separation of Mathura; hatha mare nija-buke — beats His own breast with His hand

18Agitated by the mood of Radha, the Lord calls out
and in separation from [Krishna gone to] Mathura beats His breast with His hand:

আরে রে অক্রূর মোর কৃষ্ণ লঞা গেলি ।
ইহা বলি কান্দে প্রভু করিয়া বিকুলি ॥ ১৯ ॥

āre re akrūra mora kṛṣṇa lañā geli |
ihā bali kānde prabhu kariẏā bikuli || 19 ||

are re akrura — ah, Akrura; mora krishna lana geli — you have taken my Krishna away; iha bali — saying this; kande prabhu — the Lord weeps; kariya vikuli — lamenting

19"Ah, Akrura! You have carried off my Krishna!" —
saying this, the Lord weeps and laments.

কুবুজা কুৎসিতমতি কৃষ্ণ নিল মোর ।
শঠরতি লম্পট যুবতী-মন-চোর ॥ ২০ ॥

kubujā kutsitamati kṛṣṇa nila mora |
śaṭharati lampaṭa yubatī-mana-cora || 20 ||

kubuja kutsita-mati — Kubja of base mind; krishna nila mora — has taken my Krishna; shatha-rati — the cheat in love; lampata — the rake; yuvati-mana-chora — the thief of young women's hearts

20"Kubja, with her base mind, has taken my Krishna —
the cheat in love, the rake, the thief of young women's hearts!"3

ইহা বলি কান্দে প্রভু গরজে হুঙ্কার ।
পুলকে আকুল অঙ্গ ভাব চমৎকার ॥ ২১ ॥

ihā bali kānde prabhu garaje huṅkāra |
pulake ākula aṅga bhāba camatkāra || 21 ||

iha bali — saying this; kande prabhu — the Lord weeps; garaje hunkara — cries aloud; pulake akula anga — His body thrills with hair on end; bhava chamatkara — a wondrous bhava

21Saying this, the Lord weeps and cries aloud;
His body thrills, His hair stands on end — a wondrous bhava.

বিস্মিত হইয়া শচী বিশ্বম্ভরে পুছে ।
কি লাগিয়া কান্দ বাপ দুঃখ তোর কিসে ॥ ২২ ॥

bismita haiẏā śacī biśbambhare puche |
ki lāgiẏā kānda bāpa duḥkha tora kise || 22 ||

vismita haiya — astonished; shachi vishvambhare puchhe — Shachi asks Vishvambhara; ki lagiya kanda — why do You weep; bapa — my son; duhkha tora kise — what is Your sorrow

22Astonished, Shachi asks Vishvambhara:
"Why are You weeping, my son? What is Your sorrow?"

মায়ের বচন শুনি না দিয়া উত্তর ।
রোদন করয়ে প্রভু আনন্দে বিভোর ॥ ২৩ ॥

māẏera bacana śuni nā diẏā uttara |
rodana karaẏe prabhu ānande bibhora || 23 ||

mayera vachana shuni — hearing His mother's words; na diya uttara — giving no answer; rodana karaye prabhu — the Lord weeps; anande bibhora — beside Himself with bliss

23Hearing His mother's words, the Lord gave no answer
and weeps, beside Himself with bliss.

তবে সেই শচীদেবী মনে মনে গণে ।
কৃষ্ণ-অনুগ্রহ প্রেম জানিল লক্ষণে ॥ ২৪ ॥

tabe sei śacīdebī mane mane gaṇe |
kṛṣṇa-anugraha prema jānila lakṣaṇe || 24 ||

tabe sei shachidevi — then Shachi-devi; mane mane gane — reflects within herself; krishna-anugraha prema — prema, Krishna's grace; janila lakshane — she understood by the signs

24Then Shachi-devi, reflecting within herself,
understood by the signs: this is prema — Krishna's grace.

বড় ভাগ্যবতী শচী সর্বতত্ত্ব জানে ।
পুত্রের সম্মুখে কহে মধুর বচনে ॥ ২৫ ॥

baṛa bhāgyabatī śacī sarbatattba jāne |
putrera sammukhe kahe madhura bacane || 25 ||

bada bhagyavati shachi — most fortunate is Shachi; sarva-tattva jane — she knows all truth; putrera sammukhe — before her son; kahe madhura vachane — speaks sweet words

25Great is Shachi's fortune — she knows the whole truth;
before her son she speaks sweet words:

শুন শুন আরে বাপ মোর সোণার সুত ।
জগত-দুর্লভ তোর দেখোঁ অদ্ভুত ॥ ২৬ ॥

śuna śuna āre bāpa mora soṇāra suta |
jagata-durlabha tora dekhoṁ adbhuta || 26 ||

shuna shuna are bapa — listen, listen, my son; mora sonara suta — my golden son; jagata-durlabha — rare in the world; tora dekhon adbhuta — I see in You something wondrous

26"Listen, listen, my son, my golden son:
I see in You a wondrous [treasure], rare in the world.

যথা তথা যাও তুমি পাও যে বা ধন ।
আনিঞা আমার ঠাঞি কর সমর্পণ ॥ ২৭ ॥

yathā tathā yāo tumi pāo ye bā dhana |
āniñā āmāra ṭhāñi kara samarpaṇa || 27 ||

yatha tatha yao tumi — wherever You go; pao ye ba dhana — whatever wealth You obtain; anina amara thani — bringing it to me; kara samarpana — You hand it over

27Wherever You went, whatever wealth You obtained,
You brought it and gave it to me.

গয়াতে পাইলে কৃষ্ণপ্রেম হেন ধন ।
দেবতা-দুর্লভ বস্তু অমূল্য রতন ॥ ২৮ ॥

gaẏāte pāile kṛṣṇaprema hena dhana |
debatā-durlabha bastu amūlya ratana || 28 ||

gayate paile — in Gaya You obtained; krishna-prema hena dhana — such wealth, love for Krishna; devata-durlabha vastu — a thing rare for the gods; amulya ratana — a priceless jewel

28In Gaya You obtained such wealth — love for Krishna,
a thing rare even for the gods, a priceless jewel.

আমা প্রতি কভু যদি দয়া থাকে চিতে ।
দেহ কৃষ্ণপ্রেমধন এই চাহিতে ॥ ২৯ ॥

āmā prati kabhu yadi daẏā thāke cite |
deha kṛṣṇapremadhana ei cāhite || 29 ||

ama prati — towards me; kabhu yadi daya thake chite — if there is any compassion in Your heart; deha krishna-prema-dhana — give the wealth of love for Krishna; ei chahite — this I ask

29If there is any compassion for me in Your heart,
give me the wealth of love for Krishna — this I ask."

এতেক বচন যদি শচীদেবী বৈল ।
হৃদয় দরবে প্রভু চাহিতে লাগিল ॥ ৩০ ॥

eteka bacana yadi śacīdebī baila |
hṛdaẏa darabe prabhu cāhite lāgila || 30 ||

eteka vachana yadi — when such words; shachidevi baila — Shachi-devi spoke; hridaya darabe — the heart melted; prabhu chahite lagila — the Lord looked [at her]

30When Shachi-devi spoke such words,
the Lord's heart melted, and He looked [at her]:

বৈষ্ণব-প্রসাদে প্রেম পাবে মাতা তুমি ।
নিশ্চয় জানিহ কথা কহিলাম আমি ॥ ৩১ ॥

baiṣṇaba-prasāde prema pābe mātā tumi |
niścaẏa jāniha kathā kahilāma āmi || 31 ||

vaishnava-prasade — by the mercy of the Vaishnavas; prema pabe mata tumi — you will obtain prema, mother; nishchaya janiha katha — know it for certain; kahilama ami — I tell you

31"By the mercy of the Vaishnavas you will obtain prema, mother —
know it for certain: I am telling you.

বৈষ্ণব-গোসাঞি প্রেম দিতে নিতে পারে ।
তাহা বিনা প্রেম আর কেহো দিতে নারে ॥ ৩১+১ ॥

baiṣṇaba-gosāñi prema dite nite pāre |
tāhā binā prema āra keho dite nāre || 31+1 ||

vaishnava-gosani — the Vaishnava gosanis; prema — prema; dite nite pare — can give and take away; taha vina — apart from them; prema ara keho — prema no one else; dite nare — can give

31+1The Vaishnava gosanis can give prema and take it away;
apart from them no one else can give prema"4.

এ বোল শুনিঞা শচী অতি হৃষ্টচিত ।
তখনে পাইল প্রেমভক্তি আচম্বিত ॥ ৩২ ॥

e bola śuniñā śacī ati hṛṣṭacita |
takhane pāila premabhakti ācambita || 32 ||

e bola shunina — hearing these words; shachi ati hrishta-chita — Shachi was overjoyed; takhane paila — at once obtained; prema-bhakti — prema-bhakti; achambita — unexpectedly

32Hearing these words, Shachi was overjoyed
and at once, unexpectedly, obtained prema-bhakti.

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ কম্প কলেবর ।
নয়নে গলয়ে অশ্রুধারা নিরন্তর ॥ ৩৩ ॥

pulakita saba aṅga kampa kalebara |
naẏane galaẏe aśrudhārā nirantara || 33 ||

pulakita saba anga — the whole body thrills; kampa kalevara — the body trembles; nayane galaye — from the eyes flow; ashru-dhara nirantara — streams of tears ceaselessly

33Her whole body thrills, her body trembles,
streams of tears flow ceaselessly from her eyes.

কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ বলি ডাকে হৃদয়-উল্লাস ।
কহয়ে লোচন গোরা-প্রথম-প্রকাশ ॥ ৩৪ ॥

kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa bali ḍāke hṛdaẏa-ullāsa |
kahaẏe locana gorā-prathama-prakāśa || 34 ||

krishna krishna bali dake — she calls "Krishna, Krishna!"; hridaya-ullasa — her heart rejoicing; kahaye lochana — Lochana tells; gora-prathama-prakasha — of Gora's first manifestation

34"Krishna, Krishna!" she calls, her heart rejoicing. —
Thus Lochana tells of Gora's first manifestation.

Raga shri

তবে বিশ্বম্ভর পহুঁ প্রেমে গরগর ।
আছয়ে ব্রাহ্মণ ব্রহ্মচারী শুক্লাম্বর ॥ ৩৫ ॥

tabe biśbambhara pahuṁ preme garagara |
āchaẏe brāhmaṇa brahmacārī śuklāmbara || 35 ||

tabe — then; vishvambhara pahun — the Lord Vishvambhara; preme garagara — overwhelmed with love; achhaye brahmana — there was a brahmana; brahmachari shuklambara — the brahmachari Shuklambara

35Then the Lord Vishvambhara, overwhelmed with love, —
[in Navadvipa] there lived a brahmana, the brahmachari Shuklambara, —

তার ঘরে কান্দে প্রভু প্রেমায় বিভোর ।
নয়নে গলয়ে অশ্রুধারা নিরন্তর ॥ ৩৬ ॥

tāra ghare kānde prabhu premāẏa bibhora |
naẏane galaẏe aśrudhārā nirantara || 36 ||

tara ghare — in his house; kande prabhu — the Lord weeps; premaya bibhora — lost in prema; nayane galaye ashru-dhara nirantara — streams of tears flow ceaselessly from the eyes

36in his house the Lord weeps, lost in prema;
streams of tears flow ceaselessly from His eyes.

নাসিকায় বহে শ্লেষ্মা অতি নিরন্তর ।
নিরবধি ফেলে তাহা বিপ্র শুক্লাম্বর ॥ ৩৭ ॥

nāsikāẏa bahe śleṣmā ati nirantara |
nirabadhi phele tāhā bipra śuklāmbara || 37 ||

nasikaya bahe shleshma — mucus flows from the nose; ati nirantara — ceaselessly; niravadhi phele taha — keeps wiping it away; vipra shuklambara — the brahmana Shuklambara

37Mucus flows ceaselessly from His nose,
and the brahmana Shuklambara keeps wiping it away.

ভূমেতে লুটাঞা কান্দে রজনী দিবস ।
সন্ধ্যার সময়ে প্রশ্ন করয়ে বিবশ ॥ ৩৮ ॥

bhūmete luṭāñā kānde rajanī dibasa |
sandhyāra samaẏe praśna karaẏe bibaśa || 38 ||

bhumete lutana — rolling on the ground; kande rajani divasa — He weeps night and day; sandhyara samaye — at dusk; prashna karaye vivasha — beside Himself, He asks

38Rolling on the ground, He weeps day and night;
at dusk, beside Himself, He asks [the time]:

দিবসে পুছয়ে প্রভু কত রাত্রি যায় ।
সব-জন কহে দিবা রাত্রি নাহি হয় ॥ ৩৯ ॥

dibase puchaẏe prabhu kata rātri yāẏa |
saba-jana kahe dibā rātri nāhi haẏa || 39 ||

divase puchhaye prabhu — in the daytime the Lord asks; kata ratri yaya — how much of the night has passed; saba-jana kahe — all say; diva — it is day; ratri nahi haya — it is not night

39in the daytime the Lord asks: "How much of the night has passed?"
All say: "It is day now, not night."

তবে সেইমত প্রভু প্রেমাতে বিবশ ।
রোদন করয়ে পুনঃ আনন্দে অবশ ॥ ৪০ ॥

tabe seimata prabhu premāte bibaśa |
rodana karaẏe punaḥ ānande abaśa || 40 ||

tabe seimata — thus; prabhu premate vivasha — the Lord overpowered by prema; rodana karaye punah — weeps again; anande avasha — helpless with bliss

40Thus the Lord, overpowered by prema,
weeps again, helpless with bliss.

প্রহরেক রাত্রি গেলে দিন বলি পুছে ।
দিন নাহি হয় কহে কাছে যত আছে ॥ ৪১ ॥

prahareka rātri gele dina bali puche |
dina nāhi haẏa kahe kāche yata āche || 41 ||

prahareka ratri gele — when a watch of the night has passed; dina bali puchhe — He asks, [thinking it] day; dina nahi haya — it is not day; kahe kachhe yata achhe — say all who are near

41When a watch of the night has passed, He asks, [thinking it] day;
"It is not yet day," say all who are near.

প্রেমায় বিভোর নাহি জানে দিবা-রাতি ।
কারো মুখে কৃষ্ণনাম শুনি পড়ে ক্ষিতি ॥ ৪২ ॥

premāẏa bibhora nāhi jāne dibā-rāti |
kāro mukhe kṛṣṇanāma śuni paṛe kṣiti || 42 ||

premaya bibhora — lost in prema; nahi jane diva-rati — He does not know day from night; karo mukhe — from anyone's lips; krishna-nama shuni — hearing the name of Krishna; pade kshiti — He falls to the ground

42Lost in prema, He does not know day from night;
hearing the name of Krishna from anyone's lips, He falls to the ground.

কৃষ্ণ-গুণ-নাম-গীত কেহ যদি গায় ।
শুনিঞা তখনি কান্দে ভূমেতে লুটায় ॥ ৪৩ ॥

kṛṣṇa-guṇa-nāma-gīta keha yadi gāẏa |
śuniñā takhani kānde bhūmete luṭāẏa || 43 ||

krishna-guna-nama-gita — a song of Krishna's qualities and names; keha yadi gaya — if anyone sings; shunina takhani — hearing it, at once; kande — He weeps; bhumete lutaya — rolls on the ground

43If anyone sings a song of Krishna's names and qualities,
He, hearing it, at once weeps, rolling on the ground.

ক্ষণে দণ্ডবত করি করে পরণাম ।
ক্ষণে উচ্চস্বর করি গায় কৃষ্ণনাম ॥ ৪৪ ॥

kṣaṇe daṇḍabata kari kare paraṇāma |
kṣaṇe uccasbara kari gāẏa kṛṣṇanāma || 44 ||

kshane dandavata kari — now prostrating Himself; kare paranama — bows down; kshane uchchasvara kari — now in a loud voice; gaya krishna-nama — sings the name of Krishna

44Now He prostrates Himself and bows down,
now He sings the name of Krishna in a loud voice.

সকরুণ কণ্ঠ ক্ষণে কম্প কলেবর ।
পুলকিত অঙ্গ জিনি কদম্ব-কেশর ॥ ৪৫ ॥

sakaruṇa kaṇṭha kṣaṇe kampa kalebara |
pulakita aṅga jini kadamba-keśara || 45 ||

sakaruna kantha — the voice full of entreaty; kshane — at times; kampa kalevara — the body trembles; pulakita anga — the hair on the body stands on end; jini kadamba-keshara — like kadamba filaments

45Now His voice is full of entreaty, now His body trembles,
His hair stands on end like the filaments of the kadamba.

নিরন্তর পরবশ ক্ষণেক প্রবোধে ।
সেইক্ষণে স্নান-দান জন-অনুরোধে ॥ ৪৬ ॥

nirantara parabaśa kṣaṇeka prabodhe |
seikṣaṇe snāna-dāna jana-anurodhe || 46 ||

nirantara paravasha — all the time beside Himself; kshaneka prabodhe — comes to His senses for a moment; sei-kshane — at that time; snana-dana — bathing and giving gifts; jana-anurodhe — at people's request

46All the time He is beside Himself and only for a moment comes to His senses —
then, at people's request, He bathes and gives gifts.

সেইকালে পূজা করে অন্ন-নিবেদন ।
ভোজন করয়ে মহাপ্রসাদ তখন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

seikāle pūjā kare anna-nibedana |
bhojana karaẏe mahāprasāda takhana || 47 ||

seikale — at that time; puja kare — He performs worship; anna-nivedana — offers food; bhojana karaye — partakes; mahaprasada takhana — of mahaprasada then

47Then too He performs worship, offers food [to the Deity]
and partakes of mahaprasada.

হেনমতে আনন্দে-কৌতুকে দিন যায় ।
সকল রজনী নিজসুখে নাচে গায় ॥ ৪৮ ॥

henamate ānande-kautuke dina yāẏa |
sakala rajanī nijasukhe nāce gāẏa || 48 ||

henamate — thus; anande-kautuke — in joy and delight; dina yaya — the day passes; sakala rajani — all night; nija-sukhe — in His own happiness; nache gaya — dances and sings

48Thus in joy and delight the day passes,
and all night long He, happy, dances and sings.

হেনমতে কৌতুকে সে রজনী-দিবস ।
লোকশিক্ষা করে প্রভু ভুঞ্জে প্রেমরস ॥ ৪৯ ॥

henamate kautuke se rajanī-dibasa |
lokaśikṣā kare prabhu bhuñje premarasa || 49 ||

henamate kautuke — thus in delight; se rajani-divasa — night and day; loka-shiksha kare prabhu — the Lord teaches the people; bhunje prema-rasa — tastes the rasa of prema

49Thus in delight — day and night:
the Lord teaches the people and tastes the rasa of prema.

আপনে আপন-রস করে আস্বাদন ।
মুখ্য এই হেতু কথা শুন সর্বজন ॥ ৫০ ॥

āpane āpana-rasa kare āsbādana |
mukhya ei hetu kathā śuna sarbajana || 50 ||

apane — Himself; apana-rasa — His own rasa; kare asvadana — He tastes; mukhya ei hetu — this is the chief reason; katha shuna sarvajana — listen, all of you

50He Himself tastes His own rasa —
this is the chief reason; listen, all of you.

জীব-উদ্ধারণ-হেতু গৌণ করি মানি ।
এইহেতু অবতার বলি শিরোমণি ॥ ৫১ ॥

jība-uddhāraṇa-hetu gauṇa kari māni |
eihetu abatāra bali śiromaṇi || 51 ||

jiva-uddharana-hetu — the deliverance of souls as a reason; gauna kari mani — I regard as secondary; ei-hetu — therefore; avatara bali shiromani — He is called the crown jewel of avataras

51The deliverance of souls I consider a secondary reason;
that is why He is called the crown jewel of avataras5.

সব অবতারাবলি দেহেতে প্রকাশ ।
সব অবতার-সঙ্গী সঙ্গে সব দাস ॥ ৫২ ॥

saba abatārābali dehete prakāśa |
saba abatāra-saṅgī saṅge saba dāsa || 52 ||

saba avataravali — the whole series of avataras; dehete prakasha — is manifest in the body; saba avatara-sangi — the associates of all avataras; sange — with Him; saba dasa — all servants

52In His body the whole series of avataras is manifest;
the associates of all the avataras are with Him, all [His] servants.

নবদ্বীপে উদয় করিল গৌরচন্দ্র ।
দূর কৈল জগজন-হৃদয়ের অন্ধ ॥ ৫৩ ॥

nabadbīpe udaẏa karila gauracandra |
dūra kaila jagajana-hṛdaẏera andha || 53 ||

navadvipe udaya karila — rose in Navadvipa; gaurachandra — Gaurachandra; dura kaila — dispelled; jagajana-hridayera andha — the blindness of the hearts of the world's people

53Gaurachandra has risen in Navadvipa
and dispelled the blindness in the hearts of the people of the world.

করুণা-কিরণে কলিযুগ হৈল আলা ।
ঘুচিল সকল লোকের হৃদয়ের জ্বালা ॥ ৫৪ ॥

karuṇā-kiraṇe kaliyuga haila ālā |
ghucila sakala lokera hṛdaẏera jbālā || 54 ||

karuna-kirane — by the rays of compassion; kaliyuga haila ala — the age of Kali was lit up; ghuchila — was quenched; sakala lokera hridayera jvala — the burning in the hearts of all people

54By the rays of His compassion the age of Kali was lit up,
the burning in the hearts of all people was quenched.

ভকত-চকোর সব আসিয়া মিলিলা ।
প্রেমামৃত-পান করি সভাই ভুলিলা ॥ ৫৫ ॥

bhakata-cakora saba āsiẏā mililā |
premāmṛta-pāna kari sabhāi bhulilā || 55 ||

bhakata-chakora saba — all the chakora-devotees; asiya milila — came and gathered; premamrita-pana kari — drinking the nectar of prema; sabhai bhulila — all lost themselves

55All the chakora-devotees came and gathered together;
drinking the nectar of prema, all lost themselves.

মিলিলেন গদাধর-পণ্ডিত গোসাঞি ।
নরহরি মিলিয়া রহিলা তার ঠাঞি ॥ ৫৬ ॥

mililena gadādhara-paṇḍita gosāñi |
narahari miliẏā rahilā tāra ṭhāñi || 56 ||

mililena — came; gadadhara-pandita gosani — Gadadhara Pandita Gosani; narahari miliya — Narahari, coming; rahila tara thani — remained with him

56Gadadhara Pandita Gosani came,
and Narahari came and remained with him.

শ্রীনিবাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ বক্রেশ্বর ।
শ্রীধর-পণ্ডিত নবদ্বীপে যার ঘর ॥ ৫৭ ॥

śrīnibāsa murāri mukunda bakreśbara |
śrīdhara-paṇḍita nabadbīpe yāra ghara || 57 ||

shrinivasa murari mukunda vakreshvara — Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Vakreshvara; shridhara-pandita — Shridhara Pandita; navadvipe yara ghara — whose home is in Navadvipa

57Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Vakreshvara,
Shridhara Pandita, whose home is in Navadvipa,

শ্রীমান্ সঞ্জয় পণ্ডিত ধনঞ্জয় ।
শুক্লাম্বর নীলাম্বর-আদি মহাশয় ॥ ৫৮ ॥

śrīmān sañjaẏa paṇḍita dhanañjaẏa |
śuklāmbara nīlāmbara-ādi mahāśaẏa || 58 ||

shriman — Shriman; sanjaya — Sanjaya; pandita dhananjaya — Pandita Dhananjaya; shuklambara — Shuklambara; nilambara-adi — Nilambara and others; mahashaya — great souls

58Shriman, Sanjaya, Pandita Dhananjaya,
Shuklambara, Nilambara and other great souls,

শ্রীরামপণ্ডিত আর মহেশপণ্ডিত ।
হরিদাস নন্দন-আচার্য সুচরিত ॥ ৫৯ ॥

śrīrāmapaṇḍita āra maheśapaṇḍita |
haridāsa nandana-ācārya sucarita || 59 ||

shrirama-pandita — Sri Rama Pandita; ara mahesha-pandita — and Mahesha Pandita; haridasa — Haridasa; nandana-acharya — Nandana Acharya; sucharita — the righteous

59Sri Rama Pandita and Mahesha Pandita,
Haridasa, Nandana Acharya — the righteous,

রুদ্রপণ্ডিত আর পণ্ডিত দামোদর ।
অনেক মিলিলা সে গৌরাঙ্গ-অনুচর ॥ ৬০ ॥

rudrapaṇḍita āra paṇḍita dāmodara |
aneka mililā se gaurāṅga-anucara || 60 ||

rudra-pandita — Rudra Pandita; ara pandita damodara — and Pandita Damodara; aneka milila — many gathered; se gauranga-anuchara — the followers of Gauranga

60Rudra Pandita and Pandita Damodara —
many followers of Gauranga gathered.

নামক্রমে লিখন না হয় তা-সভার ।
সম্বরণ নহে গ্রন্থ হয় ত অপার ॥ ৬১ ॥

nāmakrame likhana nā haẏa tā-sabhāra |
sambaraṇa nahe grantha haẏa ta apāra || 61 ||

nama-krame — by name in order; likhana na haya — it is impossible to write; ta-sabhara — of them all; sambarana nahe — it could not be finished; grantha haya ta apara — the book would be endless

61It is impossible to list them all by name:
the book could not be finished — it would become endless.

নানাদেশে যতেক আছিলা ভক্তগণ ।
সভেই মিলিলা আসি প্রভুর চরণ ॥ ৬২ ॥

nānādeśe yateka āchilā bhaktagaṇa |
sabhei mililā āsi prabhura caraṇa || 62 ||

nanadeshe — in various lands; yateka achhila bhakta-gana — all the devotees who were; sabhei milila asi — all came and gathered; prabhura charana — at the Lord's feet

62All the devotees who lived in various lands
came and gathered at the Lord's feet.

মহাপ্রেমে উন্মত্ত হইলা ভক্তগণ ।
মাতাইলা সর্বলোকে দিয়া প্রেমধন ॥ ৬৩ ॥

mahāpreme unmatta hailā bhaktagaṇa |
mātāilā sarbaloke diẏā premadhana || 63 ||

maha-preme — with great prema; unmatta haila bhakta-gana — the devotees were maddened; mataila sarvaloke — they intoxicated all people; diya prema-dhana — giving the wealth of prema

63The devotees were maddened with great prema
and intoxicated all the people, giving them the wealth of prema.

সমভাবে সব-জীবে করুণা করিয়া ।
ভক্তসঙ্গে বুলে গোরা প্রেমবিনোদিয়া ॥ ৬৪ ॥

samabhābe saba-jībe karuṇā kariẏā |
bhaktasaṅge bule gorā premabinodiẏā || 64 ||

samabhave — equally; saba-jive karuna kariya — showing compassion to all beings; bhakta-sange — with the devotees; bule gora — Gora goes about; prema-vinodiya — delighting in prema

64Equally compassionate to all living beings,
Gora goes about with the devotees, delighting in prema.

তবে সেই বিশ্বম্ভর আর একদিনে ।
শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত আর তার ভ্রাতৃগণে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

tabe sei biśbambhara āra ekadine |
śrībāsapaṇḍita āra tāra bhrātṛgaṇe || 65 ||

tabe sei vishvambhara — then Vishvambhara; ara ekadine — one day; shrivasa-pandita — Srivasa Pandita; ara tara bhratri-gane — and his brothers

65And then one day Vishvambhara,
with Srivasa Pandita and his brothers —

এ-সব-সহিতে প্রভু পথে চলি যায় ।
শুনয়ে বংশীর ধ্বনি না জানি কে গায় ॥ ৬৬ ॥

e-saba-sahite prabhu pathe cali yāẏa |
śunaẏe baṃśīra dhbani nā jāni ke gāẏa || 66 ||

e-saba-sahite — with all of them; prabhu pathe chali yaya — the Lord walks along the road; shunaye vamshira dhvani — He hears the sound of a flute; na jani ke gaya — no one knows who plays

66with all of them the Lord walks along the road
and hears the sound of a flute — no one knows who is playing.

গান্ধর্বার ভাবে বংশীধ্বনি যে শুনিঞা ।
কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া বুলে ডাকিয়া ডাকিয়া ॥ ৬৭ ॥

gāndharbāra bhābe baṃśīdhbani ye śuniñā |
kāndiẏā kāndiẏā bule ḍākiẏā ḍākiẏā || 67 ||

gandharvara bhave — in the mood of Gandharva (Radha); vamshi-dhvani ye shunina — hearing the sound of the flute; kandiya kandiya — weeping and weeping; bule — He wanders; dakiya dakiya — calling and calling

67In the mood of Gandharvika, hearing the sound of the flute,
He wanders, weeping and weeping, calling and calling6.

বিভোর হইয়া ভূমে দণ্ডবত করে ।
রোদন করয়ে নানাবিধ প্রেমভরে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

bibhora haiẏā bhūme daṇḍabata kare |
rodana karaẏe nānābidha premabhare || 68 ||

bibhora haiya — beside Himself; bhume dandavata kare — He prostrates Himself on the ground; rodana karaye nanavidha — weeps in many ways; prema-bhare — overflowing with prema

68Beside Himself, He prostrates Himself on the ground
and weeps in many ways, overflowing with prema.

অবশ হইল প্রভু নির্ভর-আবেশে ।
নিজজনে আশীর্বাদ করে অট্ট হাসে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

abaśa haila prabhu nirbhara-ābeśe |
nijajane āśīrbāda kare aṭṭa hāse || 69 ||

avasha haila prabhu — the Lord became senseless; nirbhara-aveshe — wholly in the grip of bhava; nija-jane ashirvada kare — blesses His own; atta hase — laughs aloud

69The Lord is senseless, wholly in the grip of bhava;
He blesses His own and laughs aloud.

শিষ্যগণ-সঙ্গে ক্ষণে অলৌকিক কহে ।
ক্ষণে উনমাদ ক্ষণে নিঃশব্দে রহে ॥ ৭০ ॥

śiṣyagaṇa-saṅge kṣaṇe alaukika kahe |
kṣaṇe unamāda kṣaṇe niḥśabde rahe || 70 ||

shishya-gana-sange — to the students; kshane alaukika kahe — at times says unearthly things; kshane unamada — now in frenzy; kshane nihshabde rahe — now remains silent

70To His students He at times says unearthly things;
now He is in a frenzy, now He keeps silent.

শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত আর রাম নারায়ণ ।
মুকুন্দ-সহিত গেলা শ্রীবাস-ভবন ॥ ৭১ ॥

śrībāsapaṇḍita āra rāma nārāẏaṇa |
mukunda-sahita gelā śrībāsa-bhabana || 71 ||

shrivasa-pandita — Srivasa Pandita; ara rama narayana — and Rama, Narayana; mukunda-sahita — with Mukunda; gela shrivasa-bhavana — went to Srivasa's house

71Srivasa Pandita, Rama and Narayana,
together with Mukunda, came [with Him] to Srivasa's house.

চৌদিকে বেঢ়িয়া ভক্ত মাঝে গৌরহরি ।
মদে মাতোয়াল যেন কিশোর-কিশোরী ॥ ৭২ ॥

caudike beṛhiẏā bhakta mājhe gaurahari |
made mātoẏāla yena kiśora-kiśorī || 72 ||

chaudike bedhiya bhakta — the devotees all around; majhe gaurahari — Gaurahari in the midst; made matoyala — intoxicated; yena kishora-kishori — like Kishora and Kishori

72All around are the devotees, and in the midst is Gaurahari,
intoxicated like the Youthful Couple7.

ক্ষণে উঠে ক্ষণে পড়ে ভূমিতে লোটায় ।
হরি হরি বলি ডাকে কান্দে উচ্চরায় ॥ ৭৩ ॥

kṣaṇe uṭhe kṣaṇe paṛe bhūmite loṭāẏa |
hari hari bali ḍāke kānde uccarāẏa || 73 ||

kshane uthe — now rises; kshane pade — now falls; bhumite lotaya — rolls on the ground; hari hari bali dake — cries "Hari, Hari!"; kande uchcharaya — weeps aloud

73Now He rises, now falls and rolls on the ground,
cries "Hari, Hari!" and weeps aloud.

রাত্রিদিনে প্রেমানন্দে পুলকিত তনু ।
আন-পরসঙ্গ নাহি কৃষ্ণকথা বিনু ॥ ৭৪ ॥

rātridine premānande pulakita tanu |
āna-parasaṅga nāhi kṛṣṇakathā binu || 74 ||

ratri-dine — night and day; premanande — with the bliss of prema; pulakita tanu — the body thrills; ana-parasanga nahi — there is no other talk; krishna-katha vinu — but talk of Krishna

74Day and night His body thrills with the bliss of prema;
there is no other talk than talk of Krishna.

এককালে নিজঘরে আছে প্রেমে ভোরা ।
রোদন করয়ে আঁখে সাত-পাঁচ-ধারা ॥ ৭৫ ॥

ekakāle nijaghare āche preme bhorā |
rodana karaẏe āṁkhe sāta-pāṁca-dhārā || 75 ||

eka-kale — once; nija-ghare achhe — at His home; preme bhora — absorbed in prema; rodana karaye — weeps; ankhe — from the eyes; sata-pancha-dhara — in seven or five streams

75Once, when He was at home, absorbed in prema,
tears flowed from His eyes in seven or five streams:

কি করিব কোথা যাব কেমন উপায় ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণে আমার মতি কোন মতে হয় ॥ ৭৬ ॥

ki kariba kothā yāba kemana upāẏa |
śrīkṛṣṇe āmāra mati kona mate haẏa || 76 ||

ki kariba — what shall I do; kotha yaba — where shall I go; kemana upaya — what means; shri-krishne amara mati — that My mind towards Sri Krishna; kona mate haya — may somehow turn

76"What shall I do? Where shall I go? What means shall I find
so that My mind may somehow turn to Sri Krishna?"

ইহা বলি রোদন করয়ে আর্তনাদে ।
কাতর বচন শুনি সর্বলোক কান্দে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

ihā bali rodana karaẏe ārtanāde |
kātara bacana śuni sarbaloka kānde || 77 ||

iha bali — saying this; rodana karaye artanade — He sobs with anguished cries; katara vachana shuni — hearing the plaintive words; sarvaloka kande — all the people weep

77Saying this, He sobs with anguished cries;
hearing His plaintive words, all the people weep.

হেনকালে দৈববাণী উঠিল সাদরে ।
আপনে ঈশ্বর তুমি শুন বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ৭৮ ॥

henakāle daibabāṇī uṭhila sādare |
āpane īśbara tumi śuna biśbambhare || 78 ||

henakale — then; daiva-vani uthila — a heavenly voice arose; sadare — tenderly; apane ishvara tumi — You are Ishvara Himself; shuna vishvambhare — listen, Vishvambhara

78Then a heavenly voice resounded tenderly:
"You are Ishvara Himself; listen, Vishvambhara!

প্রেম প্রকাশিতে মহী কৈলে অবতার ।
নিজ-করুণায় প্রেমা করিবে প্রচার ॥ ৭৯ ॥

prema prakāśite mahī kaile abatāra |
nija-karuṇāẏa premā karibe pracāra || 79 ||

prema prakashite — to reveal prema; mahi kaile avatara — You descended to the earth; nija-karunaya — by Your own mercy; prema karibe prachara — You will preach prema

79You have descended to the earth to reveal prema;
by Your own mercy You will preach prema.

ধর্মসংস্থাপন ক্ষিতি করিবে কীর্তন ।
খেদ না করিহ কর কৃষ্ণসঙ্কীর্তন ॥ ৮০ ॥

dharmasaṃsthāpana kṣiti karibe kīrtana |
kheda nā kariha kara kṛṣṇasaṅkīrtana || 80 ||

dharma-samsthapana kshiti — establishing dharma on earth; karibe kirtana — You will perform kirtana; kheda na kariha — do not grieve; kara krishna-sankirtana — perform the kirtana of Krishna

80You will establish dharma on earth and perform kirtana;
do not grieve — perform the kirtana of Krishna.

তোমার প্রসাদে কলি নিস্তারিব লোক ।
নিজ-প্রেম দিয়া সব ঘুচাইব শোক ॥ ৮১ ॥

tomāra prasāde kali nistāriba loka |
nija-prema diẏā saba ghucāiba śoka || 81 ||

tomara prasade — by Your mercy; kali — in Kali; nistariba loka — people will be delivered; nija-prema diya — giving Your prema; saba ghuchaiba shoka — You will dispel all sorrows

81By Your mercy in Kali the people will be delivered;
giving them Your prema, You will dispel all their sorrows.

সংশয় নাহিক ইথে শুনহ বচন ।
খেদ দূর করি কর নিজ-সঙ্কীর্তন ॥ ৮২ ॥

saṃśaẏa nāhika ithe śunaha bacana |
kheda dūra kari kara nija-saṅkīrtana || 82 ||

samshaya nahika ithe — there is no doubt in this; shunaha vachana — listen to these words; kheda dura kari — casting off grief; kara nija-sankirtana — perform Your sankirtana

82There is no doubt in this — listen to these words:
cast off Your grief and perform Your sankirtana."

এতেক বচন যবে দৈবমুখে শুনি ।
অন্তর হরিষ কিছু না কহিল বাণী ॥ ৮৩ ॥

eteka bacana yabe daibamukhe śuni |
antara hariṣa kichu nā kahila bāṇī || 83 ||

eteka vachana — these words; yabe daiva-mukhe shuni — when He heard from the lips of the gods; antara harisha — His heart rejoiced; kichhu na kahila vani — He said not a word

83When He heard these words from the lips of the gods,
His heart rejoiced, but He did not say a word8.

তার-পর-দিনে শুন অপরূপ কথা ।
অমিয়া-মাখিল বিশ্বম্ভর-গুণগাথা ॥ ৮৪ ॥

tāra-para-dine śuna aparūpa kathā |
amiẏā-mākhila biśbambhara-guṇagāthā || 84 ||

tara-para-dine — on the next day; shuna aparupa katha — hear a wondrous tale; amiya-makhila — steeped in nectar; vishvambhara-guna-gatha — the account of Vishvambhara's glories

84On the next day — listen to a wondrous tale,
the nectar-steeped account of Vishvambhara's glories.

মুরারিগুপ্তের ঘর গেলা একদিন ।
পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ আবেশের চিন ॥ ৮৫ ॥

murāriguptera ghara gelā ekadina |
pulakita saba aṅga ābeśera cina || 85 ||

murari-guptera ghara — to Murari Gupta's house; gela ekadina — He came one day; pulakita saba anga — His whole body thrills; aveshera china — signs of bhava

85One day He came to the house of Murari Gupta;
His whole body thrills — signs of bhava.

দেবতার ঘরমধ্যে প্রবেশ করিল ।
আবেশে বিভোল কিছু কহিতে লাগিল ॥ ৮৬ ॥

debatāra gharamadhye prabeśa karila |
ābeśe bibhola kichu kahite lāgila || 86 ||

devatara ghara-madhye — into the shrine; pravesha karila — He entered; aveshe bibhola — beside Himself in bhava; kichhu kahite lagila — began to say something

86He entered the shrine
and, beside Himself in bhava, began to say something.

প্রেম-নীর-ধারা বহে নয়ান-সাগরে ।
সুরধুনী-ধারা যেন সুমেরু-শিখরে ॥ ৮৭ ॥

prema-nīra-dhārā bahe naẏāna-sāgare |
suradhunī-dhārā yena sumeru-śikhare || 87 ||

prema-nira-dhara — streams of tears of love; bahe nayana-sagare — flow from the oceans of the eyes; suradhuni-dhara — the streams of the heavenly Ganga; yena sumeru-shikhare — as on the peak of Sumeru

87From the oceans of His eyes flow streams of tears of love,
like the heavenly Ganga from the peak of Sumeru.

কহে সব লোক হের দেখ অপরূপ ।
পর্বত-আকার এক বরাহ সম্মুখ ॥ ৮৮ ॥

kahe saba loka hera dekha aparūpa |
parbata-ākāra eka barāha sammukha || 88 ||

kahe saba loka — He says to all; hera dekha aparupa — look, a wonder; parvata-akara — as large as a mountain; eka baraha sammukha — a boar before Me

88He says to all: "Look — a wonder:
before Me is a boar as large as a mountain!

মহাবেগে আইসে হের দেখহ বরাহে ।
দন্ত সারি আইসে মোরে মারিবারে চাহে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

mahābege āise hera dekhaha barāhe |
danta sāri āise more māribāre cāhe || 89 ||

maha-vege aise — at great speed he comes; hera dekhaha barahe — look, the boar; danta sari aise — baring his tusks he comes; more maribare chahe — he wants to kill Me

89At great speed he rushes on — look, the boar!
Baring his tusks, he rushes on, he wants to kill Me.

দুই দন্ত সারি মোরে মারিবে শূকর ।
ইহা বলি প্রবেশিলা দেবতার ঘর ॥ ৯০ ॥

dui danta sāri more māribe śūkara |
ihā bali prabeśilā debatāra ghara || 90 ||

dui danta sari — baring two tusks; more maribe shukara — the boar will kill Me; iha bali — saying this; praveshila devatara ghara — He entered the shrine

90Baring his two tusks, this boar will kill Me!" —
saying this, He entered the shrine.

বরাহ-আবেশ পুনঃ হইল তখন ।
কর-চরণেতে মহী করে পর্যটন ॥ ৯১ ॥

barāha-ābeśa punaḥ haila takhana |
kara-caraṇete mahī kare paryaṭana || 91 ||

baraha-avesha — the mood of the Boar; punah haila takhana — then came again; kara-charanete — on hands and feet; mahi kare paryatana — He moves about the ground

91Then the mood of the Boar again took hold of Him:
on hands and feet He moves about the ground.

বর্তুল আকার রাঙ্গা-বরণ লোচন ।
মহা পরাক্রম মহা হুঙ্কার-গর্জন ॥ ৯২ ॥

bartula ākāra rāṅgā-baraṇa locana |
mahā parākrama mahā huṅkāra-garjana || 92 ||

vartula akara — a round form; ranga-varana lochana — eyes of red colour; maha parakrama — great might; maha hunkara-garjana — a loud roar and bellowing

92His form is round, His eyes are red,
great might, a loud roar and bellowing.

সেইখানে ছিল এক পিত্তলের পাত্র ।
ঊর্ধ্বমুখে দশনে ধরিল ক্ষণমাত্র ॥ ৯৩ ॥

seikhāne chila eka pittalera pātra |
ūrdhbamukhe daśane dharila kṣaṇamātra || 93 ||

seikhane chhila — there was there; eka pittalera patra — a brass vessel; urdhva-mukhe — with upturned snout; dashane dharila — He seized with His teeth; kshana-matra — for a moment

93A brass vessel stood there;
raising His snout, He seized it for a moment in His teeth.

পিত্তলের পাত্র ছাড়ি বিকশে বয়ান ।
মুরারিকে পুছে নিজ-স্বরূপ-আখ্যান ॥ ৯৪ ॥

pittalera pātra chāṛi bikaśe baẏāna |
murārike puche nija-sbarūpa-ākhyāna || 94 ||

pittalera patra chhadi — letting go of the brass vessel; vikashe bayana — opening His mouth; murarike puchhe — asks Murari; nija-svarupa-akhyana — to declare His own true nature

94Letting go of the brass vessel and opening His mouth,
He asks Murari to declare His true nature.

বেদ-উদ্ধারণ-রূপ ধরি ভগবান্ ।
বসিয়া কহয়ে প্রভু পুরুষ-প্রধান ॥ ৯৫ ॥

beda-uddhāraṇa-rūpa dhari bhagabān |
basiẏā kahaẏe prabhu puruṣa-pradhāna || 95 ||

veda-uddharana-rupa dhari — bearing the form of the rescuer of the Vedas; bhagavan — Bhagavan; basiya kahaye — sitting, says; prabhu purusha-pradhana — the Lord, the Supreme Person

95In the form [of the Boar] who rescued the Vedas, Bhagavan,
the Lord, the Supreme Person, sitting down, says:

কহ ত স্বরূপ মোর কি জানহ তুমি ।
মুরারি কহয়ে প্রভু কি জানিয়ে আমি ॥ ৯৬ ॥

kaha ta sbarūpa mora ki jānaha tumi |
murāri kahaẏe prabhu ki jāniẏe āmi || 96 ||

kaha ta — tell; svarupa mora — of My svarupa; ki janaha tumi — what you know; murari kahaye — Murari says; prabhu ki janiye ami — Lord, what do I know

96"Tell Me, what do you know of My svarupa?"
Murari says: "Lord, what do I know?"

দণ্ডবত করি ভূমে পড়িলা মুরারি ।
শম্ভু না জানয়ে প্রভু চরিত্র তোমারি ॥ ৯৭ ॥

daṇḍabata kari bhūme paṛilā murāri |
śambhu nā jānaẏe prabhu caritra tomāri || 97 ||

dandavata kari — prostrating; bhume padila murari — Murari fell to the ground; shambhu na janaye — [even] Shambhu does not know; prabhu — Lord; charitra tomari — Your deeds

97Prostrate on the ground, Murari [said]:
"[Even] Shambhu does not know Your deeds, Lord."

ইহা বলি পড়িল গীতার এক শ্লোক ।
প্রাকৃত-প্রবন্ধে কহি শুন সর্বলোক ॥ ৯৮ ॥

ihā bali paṛila gītāra eka śloka |
prākṛta-prabandhe kahi śuna sarbaloka || 98 ||

iha bali — saying this; padila gitara eka shloka — he recited a shloka of the Gita; prakrita-prabandhe kahi — I render it in plain speech; shuna sarvaloka — listen, all

98Saying this, he recited a shloka of the Gita;
I shall render it in plain speech — listen, all.

Thus in the Srimad Bhagavad-gita (10.15):

স্বয়মেবাত্মনাত্মানং বেত্থ ত্বং পুরুষোত্তম ।
ভূতভাবন ভূতেশ দেবদেব জগৎপতে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

sbaẏamebātmanātmānaṃ bettha tbaṃ puruṣottama |
bhūtabhābana bhūteśa debadeba jagatpate || 99 ||

svayam eva atmana atmanam — Yourself by Yourself; vettha tvam — You know; purushottama — O Supreme Person; bhuta-bhavana — Source of beings; bhutesha — Lord of beings; deva-deva — God of gods; jagat-pate — Lord of the world

99"You alone know Yourself by Yourself, O Supreme Person,
Source of beings, Lord of beings, God of gods, Lord of the world!"

আপনে আপনা তুমি জান মহাপ্রভু ।
তোমা বহি তোমারে না জানে আর কেহু ॥ ১০০ ॥

āpane āpanā tumi jāna mahāprabhu |
tomā bahi tomāre nā jāne āra kehu || 100 ||

apane apana tumi jana — You Yourself know Yourself; mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu; toma bahi — apart from You; tomare na jane — does not know You; ara kehu — anyone else

100"You Yourself know Yourself, Mahaprabhu:
apart from You no one knows You."

তবে সেই পুনরপি কহে গৌরহরি ।
বেদের শকতি আমা কি জানিতে পারি ॥ ১০১ ॥

tabe sei punarapi kahe gaurahari |
bedera śakati āmā ki jānite pāri || 101 ||

tabe — then; punarapi kahe gaurahari — Gaurahari speaks again; vedera shakati — the power of the Vedas; ama ki janite pari — can it know Me

101Then Gaurahari speaks again:
"Have the Vedas the power to know Me?"

মুরারি কহয়ে পুনঃ কাতর বচন ।
তোর তত্ত্ব নাহি জানে সহস্রবদন ॥ ১০২ ॥

murāri kahaẏe punaḥ kātara bacana |
tora tattba nāhi jāne sahasrabadana || 102 ||

murari kahaye punah — Murari speaks again; katara vachana — plaintive words; tora tattva nahi jane — does not know Your truth; sahasra-vadana — the Thousand-mouthed One

102Murari again speaks plaintively:
"Even the Thousand-mouthed One does not know Your truth.

বেদে কি জানিব তোর আচরণ-তত্ত্ব ।
কেহো নাহি জানে প্রভু তোমার মহত্ত্ব ॥ ১০৩ ॥

bede ki jāniba tora ācaraṇa-tattba |
keho nāhi jāne prabhu tomāra mahattba || 103 ||

vede ki janiba — how could the Vedas know; tora acharana-tattva — the truth of Your deeds; keho nahi jane — no one knows; prabhu — Lord; tomara mahattva — Your greatness

103How could the Vedas know the truth of Your deeds?
No one knows Your greatness, Lord."

ইহা শুনি পুনঃ কহে গৌর ভগবান্ ।
আমারে বিড়ম্বে বেদ শুনহ আখ্যান ॥ ১০৪ ॥

ihā śuni punaḥ kahe gaura bhagabān |
āmāre biṛambe beda śunaha ākhyāna || 104 ||

iha shuni — hearing this; punah kahe — speaks again; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; amare vidambe veda — the Vedas mock Me; shunaha akhyana — listen to the account

104Hearing this, Gaura Bhagavan speaks again:
"The Vedas mock Me — listen to the account."

Thus in the Shvetashvatara Upanishad (3.19):

অপাণিপাদো জবনো গ্রহীতা
পশ্যত্যচক্ষুঃ স শৃণোত্যকর্ণঃ ।
স বেত্তি বেদ্যং ন চ তস্যাস্তি বেত্তা
তমাহুরগ্র্যং পুরুষং পুরাণম্ ॥ ১০৫ ॥

apāṇipādo jabano grahītā
paśyatyacakṣuḥ sa śṛṇotyakarṇaḥ |
sa betti bedyaṃ na ca tasyāsti bettā
tamāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam || 105 ||

apani-padah — without hands and feet; javanah — swift; grahita — grasping; pashyati achakshuh — without eyes He sees; sah shrinoti akarnah — He hears without ears; sah vetti vedyam — He knows what is to be known; na cha tasya asti vetta — but there is none who knows Him; tam ahuh — they call Him; agryam purusham puranam — the first, primeval Person

105"Without hands and feet, He is swift and grasps; without eyes, He sees; without ears, He hears. He knows all that is to be known, but none knows Him; they call Him the first, primeval Person."

বেদে কহে আমি কর-চরণ-শূন্য ।
হেন বিড়ম্বনা মোরে নাহি করে অন্য ॥ ১০৬ ॥

bede kahe āmi kara-caraṇa-śūnya |
hena biṛambanā more nāhi kare anya || 106 ||

vede kahe — the Vedas say; ami kara-charana-shunya — I am without hands and feet; hena vidambana — such mockery; more nahi kare anya — no one else makes of Me

106"The Vedas say: 'I have no hands and feet' —
no one else mocks Me like this."

ইহা বলি হাসে প্রভু প্রসন্ন-বদন ।
নাহি জানে বেদ আমা কহিল কথন ॥ ১০৭ ॥

ihā bali hāse prabhu prasanna-badana |
nāhi jāne beda āmā kahila kathana || 107 ||

iha bali — saying this; hase prabhu — the Lord laughs; prasanna-vadana — with a serene face; nahi jane veda ama — the Vedas do not know Me; kahila kathana — He said

107Saying this, the Lord laughs, His face serene:
"The Vedas do not know Me" — so He said9.

তবে ত কহিল বৈদ্য করি পরণাম ।
করুণা করহ প্রভু দেহ প্রেমদান ॥ ১০৮ ॥

tabe ta kahila baidya kari paraṇāma |
karuṇā karaha prabhu deha premadāna || 108 ||

tabe ta — then; kahila vaidya — the vaidya said; kari paranama — bowing down; karuna karaha prabhu — be merciful, Lord; deha prema-dana — grant the gift of prema

108Then the vaidya [Murari], bowing down, said:
"Be merciful, Lord, grant me prema."

ঠাকুর কহিল পুনঃ শুনহ মুরারি ।
আমারে পিরীতি কর এই প্রেমা তোরি ॥ ১০৯ ॥

ṭhākura kahila punaḥ śunaha murāri |
āmāre pirīti kara ei premā tori || 109 ||

thakura kahila punah — the Thakura said again; shunaha murari — listen, Murari; amare piriti kara — love Me; ei prema tori — that is your prema

109The Thakura said again: "Listen, Murari:
love Me — that is your prema.

ভজিবে পরমব্রহ্ম নরাকৃতি তনু ।
ইন্দ্রনীল-বরণ ত্রিভঙ্গ করে বেণু ॥ ১১০ ॥

bhajibe paramabrahma narākṛti tanu |
indranīla-baraṇa tribhaṅga kare beṇu || 110 ||

bhajibe paramabrahma — worship the Parabrahman; nara-akriti tanu — whose body has human form; indranila-varana — sapphire-coloured; tribhanga — bending in three places; kare venu — flute in hand

110Worship the Parabrahman in human form:
the colour of sapphire, bending in three places, a flute in His hand, —

নবগোরোচনা-গর্ভ-গর্বভঙ্গ-দ্যুতি ।
বৃষভানুসুতা নাম মূল যে প্রকৃতি ॥ ১১১ ॥

nabagorocanā-garbha-garbabhaṅga-dyuti |
bṛṣabhānusutā nāma mūla ye prakṛti || 111 ||

nava-gorochana-garbha-garva-bhanga-dyuti — whose radiance humbles the pride of fresh gorochana; vrishabhanu-suta nama — by name the daughter of Vrishabhanu; mula ye prakriti — the original prakriti

111[and Her] whose radiance humbles the pride of fresh gorochana,
by name the daughter of Vrishabhanu, the original prakriti10.

নব ব্রজাঙ্গনা কত বল্লবী-বল্লভে ।
সমর্পিবে নিজতনু নন্দসুত-পাশে ॥ ১১২ ॥

naba brajāṅganā kata ballabī-ballabhe |
samarpibe nijatanu nandasuta-pāśe || 112 ||

nava vrajangana kata — many young beauties of Vraja; vallavi-vallabhe — to the Beloved of the cowherd girls; samarpibe nija-tanu — give themselves; nanda-suta-pashe — at the side of Nanda's son

112Many young beauties of Vraja give themselves
to the Beloved of the cowherd girls, the son of Nanda, [staying] by His side.

চিন্তামণি-ভূমি রত্ন-মন্দির সুন্দর ।
কল্পবৃক্ষ রত্নবেদী আসন উপর ॥ ১১৩ ॥

cintāmaṇi-bhūmi ratna-mandira sundara |
kalpabṛkṣa ratnabedī āsana upara || 113 ||

chintamani-bhumi — ground of chintamani; ratna-mandira sundara — a beautiful temple of jewels; kalpavriksha — a wish-fulfilling tree; ratna-vedi — a jewelled altar; asana upara — a seat upon it

113The ground [there] is chintamani, a beautiful temple of jewels,
a wish-fulfilling tree, an altar, and on it a seat.

কামধেনুগণ তথা অচিন্ত্য-প্রভাব ।
অভীষ্ট করয়ে পূর্ণ করয়ে যে ধ্যান ॥ ১১৪ ॥

kāmadhenugaṇa tathā acintya-prabhāba |
abhīṣṭa karaẏe pūrṇa karaẏe ye dhyāna || 114 ||

kamadhenu-gana tatha — there are kamadhenu cows; achintya-prabhava — of inconceivable power; abhishta karaye purna — they fulfil the desire; karaye ye dhyana — of one who meditates

114There are kamadhenu cows of inconceivable power:
they fulfil the desire of one who meditates [on this].

তার অঙ্গছটা নিরাকার ব্রহ্ম বলি ।
জানিবে এ সব তত্ত্ব কৃষ্ণের মাধুরী ॥ ১১৫ ॥

tāra aṅgachaṭā nirākāra brahma bali |
jānibe e saba tattba kṛṣṇera mādhurī || 115 ||

tara anga-chhata — the radiance of His body; nirakara brahma bali — is called the formless Brahman; janibe e saba tattva — know all this truth; krishnera madhuri — [as] the sweetness of Krishna

115The radiance of His body is called the formless Brahman.
Know: all this truth is the sweetness of Krishna"11.

এইমতে সব-ভক্তে বলিল ঠাকুর ।
শুনিঞা সভার হিয়া আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ১১৬ ॥

eimate saba-bhakte balila ṭhākura |
śuniñā sabhāra hiẏā ānanda pracura || 116 ||

eimate — thus; saba-bhakte balila thakura — the Thakura spoke to all the devotees; shunina — hearing; sabhara hiya — the hearts of all; ananda prachura — [were filled with] great joy

116Thus the Thakura spoke to all the devotees;
hearing it, the hearts of all were filled with great joy.

শুনিঞা মুরারি কহে প্রভুর চরণে ।
রঘুনাথ-রূপ প্রভু দেখিব নয়নে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

śuniñā murāri kahe prabhura caraṇe |
raghunātha-rūpa prabhu dekhiba naẏane || 117 ||

shunina murari kahe — hearing this, Murari says; prabhura charane — at the Lord's feet; raghunatha-rupa — the form of Raghunatha; prabhu — Lord; dekhiba nayane — let me see with my eyes

117Hearing this, Murari says at the Lord's feet:
"Lord, [let] me see with my eyes the form of Raghunatha."

এতেক কহিতে মাত্র দেখে সেইক্ষণে ।
দূর্বাদলশ্যাম রাম জানকী-জীবনে ॥ ১১৮ ॥

eteka kahite mātra dekhe seikṣaṇe |
dūrbādalaśyāma rāma jānakī-jībane || 118 ||

eteka kahite matra — as soon as he said this; dekhe sei-kshane — that very moment he sees; durvadala-shyama rama — Rama, dark as durva grass; janaki-jivane — the life of Janaki

118As soon as he said this, that very moment he sees:
Rama, dark as durva grass, the life of Janaki,

লক্ষ্মণ ভরত আর শত্রুঘ্নাদি যত ।
দেখিয়া মুরারি হৈল আনন্দে পূরিত ॥ ১১৯ ॥

lakṣmaṇa bharata āra śatrughnādi yata |
dekhiẏā murāri haila ānande pūrita || 119 ||

lakshmana bharata — Lakshmana, Bharata; ara shatrughnadi yata — and Shatrughna and all the others; dekhiya — seeing; murari haila anande purita — Murari was filled with bliss

119Lakshmana, Bharata, Shatrughna and all the rest.
Seeing this, Murari was filled with bliss.

বাহ্য দূরে গেল ভূমে পড়ি গড়ি যায় ।
পদ্মহস্ত দিয়া প্রভু শান্ত কৈল তায় ॥ ১২০ ॥

bāhya dūre gela bhūme paṛi gaṛi yāẏa |
padmahasta diẏā prabhu śānta kaila tāẏa || 120 ||

bahya dure gela — outer consciousness left [him]; bhume padi gadi yaya — falling to the ground he rolls; padma-hasta diya — placing His lotus hand; prabhu shanta kaila taya — the Lord calmed him

120Losing consciousness, he fell to the ground and rolls about;
the Lord, placing [on him] His lotus hand, calmed him.

বর দিল প্রেমে পরিপূর্ণ হও তুমি ।
তুমি হনুমান্ সেই রামচন্দ্র আমি ॥ ১২১ ॥

bara dila preme paripūrṇa hao tumi |
tumi hanumān sei rāmacandra āmi || 121 ||

bara dila — He gave a blessing; preme paripurna hao tumi — be full of prema; tumi hanuman — you are Hanuman; sei ramachandra ami — I am that Ramachandra

121He gave him a blessing: "Be full of prema:
you are Hanuman, and I am that same Ramachandra"12.

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা মন্দিরে ।
আর দিনে শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিতের ঘরে ॥ ১২২ ॥

e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā mandire |
āra dine śrīnibāsa-paṇḍitera ghare || 122 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu chalila mandire — the Lord went home; ara dine — on another day; shrinivasa-panditera ghare — in the house of Srinivasa Pandita

122Saying this, the Lord went home.
On another day in the house of Srinivasa Pandita,

সব নিজগণ যত সংহতি করিয়া ।
বসিয়া কহয়ে নিজ-প্রেম প্রকাশিয়া ॥ ১২৩ ॥

saba nijagaṇa yata saṃhati kariẏā |
basiẏā kahaẏe nija-prema prakāśiẏā || 123 ||

saba nija-gana yata — all His associates; samhati kariya — gathering; basiya kahaye — sitting, He speaks; nija-prema prakashiya — revealing His prema

123gathering all His associates,
He sat and speaks, revealing His prema.

হরি হরি বলি ডাকে অন্তরে কৌতুক ।
নিজজনে কহে শুন শুন অপরূপ ॥ ১২৪ ॥

hari hari bali ḍāke antare kautuka |
nijajane kahe śuna śuna aparūpa || 124 ||

hari hari bali dake — He calls "Hari, Hari!"; antare kautuka — with delight in His heart; nija-jane kahe — He says to His own; shuna shuna aparupa — listen, listen to a wonder

124Calling "Hari, Hari!", with delight in His heart,
He says to His own: "Listen, listen to a wonder:

সেই রাধাকৃষ্ণ পাবে কলিতে যেমতে ।
সে কথা কহিএ তোরে শুন একচিতে ॥ ১২৫ ॥

sei rādhākṛṣṇa pābe kalite yemate |
se kathā kahie tore śuna ekacite || 125 ||

sei radha-krishna pabe — one will attain Radha and Krishna; kalite yemate — how in Kali; se katha kahiye tore — this I tell you; shuna eka-chite — listen with undivided mind

125how in Kali one attains Radha and Krishna —
this I shall tell you; listen with undivided attention."

ইহা বলি নারদীয় পড়িল এক শ্লোক ।
ইহার মর্ম-ব্যাখ্যা নাহি জানে লোক ॥ ১২৬ ॥

ihā bali nāradīẏa paṛila eka śloka |
ihāra marma-byākhyā nāhi jāne loka || 126 ||

iha bali — saying this; naradiya padila eka shloka — He recited a shloka from the Naradiya; ihara marma-vyakhya — its inner explanation; nahi jane loka — people do not know

126Saying this, He recited a shloka from the Naradiya;
its hidden meaning people do not know.

Thus in the Brihan-naradiya Purana (38.126):

হরের্নাম হরের্নাম হরের্নামৈব কেবলম্ ।
কলৌ নাস্ত্যেব নাস্ত্যেব নাস্ত্যেব গতিরন্যথা ॥ ১২৭ ॥

harernāma harernāma harernāmaiba kebalam |
kalau nāstyeba nāstyeba nāstyeba gatiranyathā || 127 ||

hareh nama — the name of Hari; hareh nama — the name of Hari; hareh nama eva kevalam — only the name of Hari; kalau — in Kali; nasti eva nasti eva nasti eva — there is no, no, no; gatih anyatha — other way

127"The name of Hari, the name of Hari, only the name of Hari!
In Kali there is no, no, no other way."

নামরূপী নাম এক আদি যে পুরুষ ।
কলৌ মূর্তিমন্ত আছে না জানে মুরুখ ॥ ১২৮ ॥

nāmarūpī nāma eka ādi ye puruṣa |
kalau mūrtimanta āche nā jāne murukha || 128 ||

nama-rupi — the Name is [His] form; nama eka adi ye purusha — the Name is the one original Person; kalau murtimanta achhe — in Kali He is present embodied; na jane murukha — the fool does not know

128"The Name is [the Lord's] form: the Name is the one original Person;
in Kali He is present embodied — the fool does not know this.

নামরূপী ভগবান্ জানিবে কেবল ।
দ্বিধা ঘুচাইতে ব্যাস বোলে তিনবার ॥ ১২৯ ॥

nāmarūpī bhagabān jānibe kebala |
dbidhā ghucāite byāsa bole tinabāra || 129 ||

nama-rupi bhagavan — Bhagavan in the form of the Name; janibe kevala — know [this as] "kevala" ("only"); dvidha ghuchaite — to dispel doubt; vyasa bole tinabara — Vyasa says three times

129Know: 'only' means Bhagavan in the form of the Name;
to dispel doubt Vyasa says it three times.

তিনবার বহি আর আছে একবার ।
দুরাশয় পাপী লোক সব বুঝাবার ॥ ১৩০ ॥

tinabāra bahi āra āche ekabāra |
durāśaẏa pāpī loka saba bujhābāra || 130 ||

tinabara bahi — besides the three times; ara achhe ekabara — there is once more; durashaya papi loka saba — all ill-intentioned sinful people; bujhabara — to make understand

130Besides the three times there is one more ['only'],
to bring all ill-intentioned sinners to understanding.

হরিনাম-মাত্রে হয় কৈবল্য তাহার ।
কেবল কৈবল্য অর্থ জানিবে বিচার ॥ ১৩১ ॥

harināma-mātre haẏa kaibalya tāhāra |
kebala kaibalya artha jānibe bicāra || 131 ||

harinama-matre — by the name of Hari alone; haya kaivalya tahara — one attains kaivalya; kevala kaivalya artha — "kevala" means "kaivalya"; janibe vichara — understand by reflection

131By the name of Hari alone one attains kaivalya:
consider — 'kevala' means 'kaivalya'.

নামমাত্র নামাভাস স্পষ্টার্থ ইহার ।
কৈবল্য সে মুখ্য হয় শাস্ত্রপরচার ॥ ১৩২ ॥

nāmamātra nāmābhāsa spaṣṭārtha ihāra |
kaibalya se mukhya haẏa śāstraparacāra || 132 ||

nama-matra — "by the Name alone"; namabhasa — namabhasa; spashtartha ihara — its plain sense; kaivalya se mukhya haya — kaivalya is the chief [fruit]; shastra-parachara — as the shastras proclaim

132The plain sense of this: 'by the Name alone' is namabhasa;
its chief [fruit] is kaivalya, as the shastras proclaim.

নামাভাসে মোক্ষ হয় সত্য শাস্ত্রবাণী ।
নামোদয়ে প্রেমানন্দ পুরাণে বাখানি ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

nāmābhāse mokṣa haẏa satya śāstrabāṇī |
nāmodaẏe premānanda purāṇe bākhāni || 133 ||

namabhase moksha haya — by namabhasa comes liberation; satya shastra-vani — true is the word of scripture; namodaye — with the rising of the Name; premananda — the bliss of prema; purane bakhani — as the Puranas explain

133Namabhasa gives liberation — true is the word of the shastras;
but when the Name rises [in the heart] — the bliss of prema, as the Puranas explain.

ইহা বহি আন দেব মানে যেই জন ।
তার গতি নাহি তিনবার এ বচন ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

ihā bahi āna deba māne yei jana |
tāra gati nāhi tinabāra e bacana || 134 ||

iha bahi — besides this; ana deva mane — honours another god; yei jana — whoever; tara gati nahi — has no way; tinabara e vachana — [that is] the threefold word

134Whoever, besides this, honours another god
has no way — that is [the sense of] the threefold word.

গো-গোপী-গোপাল-সঙ্গে ধ্যান হরিনাম ।
জানিবে এ সব অর্থ বেদের প্রমাণ ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

go-gopī-gopāla-saṅge dhyāna harināma |
jānibe e saba artha bedera pramāṇa || 135 ||

go-gopi-gopala-sange — with the cows, gopis and cowherd boys; dhyana harinama — meditating, chant the name of Hari; janibe e saba artha — know all this meaning; vedera pramana — as confirmed by the Vedas

135Chant the name of Hari, meditating [on the Lord] with the cows, the gopis and the cowherd boys; know that all this meaning is confirmed by the Vedas"13.

এতেক বলিল গোরা বরাহ-আবেশে ।
নামসঙ্কীর্তন করে নাচে প্রেমাবেশে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

eteka balila gorā barāha-ābeśe |
nāmasaṅkīrtana kare nāce premābeśe || 136 ||

eteka balila gora — so spoke Gora; baraha-aveshe — in the mood of the Boar; nama-sankirtana kare — performs sankirtana of the Name; nache premaveshe — dances, overwhelmed by prema

136So spoke Gora in the mood of the Boar;
He performs sankirtana of the Name and dances, overwhelmed by prema14.

যে শুনয়ে গোরাগুণ নদিয়া-বিহার ।
অবিলম্বে কৃষ্ণপ্রেম উপজে তাহার ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

ye śunaẏe gorāguṇa nadiẏā-bihāra |
abilambe kṛṣṇaprema upaje tāhāra || 137 ||

ye shunaye — whoever hears; gora-guna — Gora's glories; nadiya-vihara — the pastimes in Nadia; avilambe — at once; krishna-prema upaje tahara — love for Krishna arises in him

137Whoever hears of Gora's glories and His pastimes in Nadia —
in him love for Krishna at once arises.

দশনে ধরিয়া তৃণ কহয়ে লোচন ।
গৌরপদ বিনু মোর অন্য নাহি ধন ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

daśane dhariẏā tṛṇa kahaẏe locana |
gaurapada binu mora anya nāhi dhana || 138 ||

dashane dhariya trina — holding a straw between his teeth; kahaye lochana — Lochana says; gaura-pada vinu — but for the feet of Gaura; mora anya nahi dhana — I have no other wealth

138Holding a straw between his teeth, Lochana says:
I have no other wealth than the feet of Gaura.

✦

Notes

  1. The summary covers the whole section; its end (the coming of the gods, the mercy to Shuklambara, Gadadhara) is in the next portion. Cf. Murari 2.1–2.3.
  2. A shloka from Rupa Gosvami's Padyavali. The hunter, Dhruva, Gajendra, Kubja, Sudama, Vidura, Ugrasena — devotees whom the Lord accepted for their devotion, not for their qualities. Bhaktisiddhanta's prose renderings of the shlokas (anvaya and translation) are not translated here or below.
  3. The Lord speaks in the mood of Radha separated from Krishna, whom Akrura has taken away to Mathura (cf. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary). The reproaches to Krishna ("cheat", "rake") are the language of the gopis' love in separation, not blasphemy.
  4. V. 31+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have it. Cf. Murari 2.1.9–18; in Vrindavana Dasa too (Chaitanya-bhagavata, Madhya 22) Shachi obtains prema only by the mercy of a Vaishnava (Advaita).
  5. Vv. 50–51 anticipate the teaching of Krishnadasa Kaviraja (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 4): the chief reason for Gaura's appearance is the tasting of His own rasa (Radha's love), while the deliverance of souls is a secondary reason.
  6. Gandharvika — a name of Radha. Hearing the flute, the Lord experiences what Radha experienced (so in Bhaktisiddhanta's summary). Cf. Murari 2.2.1–6.
  7. Lit. "like Kishora and Kishori" — the youthful Krishna and Radha. Gaudiya Vaishnavas see in Gaura both of Them in one form.
  8. Cf. Murari 2.2.7–10, where the voice from above likewise calls the Lord Bhagavan, descended to give people prema.
  9. Cf. Murari 2.2.11–24. The Upanishadic verse denies the Lord material hands and feet, but not a spiritual form: that is why He is "swift" and "grasps". The Lord jokingly calls it "mockery" when these words are taken as a denial of all form: the Vedas cannot describe Him directly (vv. 101–107). So also in Gaudiya Vaishnava theology: the Lord is a person with a spiritual body, and the impersonal Brahman is the radiance of His body (v. 115).
  10. "The original prakriti" (mula-prakriti) here means the Lord's original energy (shakti): Radha is the source of all His shaktis, not material nature.
  11. Cf. the Brahma-samhita (5.29, 5.40): Krishna's abode with ground of chintamani stones, wish-fulfilling trees and surabhi cows; the impersonal Brahman is the radiance of His body. In Bhaktisiddhanta's summary: the Lord told Murari to worship the son of the king of Vraja, served by the cowherd men and women.
  12. In the Rama lila Murari Gupta is Hanuman. Cf. Murari 2.7.13–18, where the Lord names him Ramadasa.
  13. Vv. 128–135 are an explanation of the verse "harer nama", following Murari (2.2.29–33). According to Lochana Dasa, the word "kevalam" ("only") points to kaivalya — liberation; but liberation is given already by namabhasa (the "shadow of the Name"), whereas the pure Name bestows prema (v. 133); so too Gaudiya Vaishnavas, following Haridasa Thakura (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Antya 3), teach that liberation is only a by-product of namabhasa. Krishnadasa Kaviraja (Adi 17.21–25) explains differently: the threefold "name of Hari" is for emphasis, and "kevala" excludes knowledge, yoga, austerity and karma.
  14. Cf. Murari 2.2.34.
